subject: Post-call: alignment + 30m demo slots (Hydra Health)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@hydrahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2024 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: alignment + 30m demo slots (Hydra Health)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and stabilize tail latency across multi-region traffic for Hydra Health's patient-facing summarization feature.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data handling (no PHI in logs), SLO: 99th pct latency < 600ms for 512-token requests, and predictable monthly spend.
- Tech stack: services in us-west-2 + eu-west-1, using k8s + Istio for traffic.

Suggested next steps:
1) 30-minute product intro/demo for the broader stakeholder group (product + eng + security) — quick live demo + Q&A.
2) Follow-up technical deep dive with Monica (SE) to go through integration, KV cache behavior, and quantization tradeoffs.
3) Share a mutual action plan (MAP) draft before the demo.

If that sounds right, can you confirm which of the following 30-minute slots works for your team? I picked windows to accommodate West Coast and London overlap: 
- Option A: Wed May 1, 2024 — 09:00–09:30 PT (noon ET)
- Option B: Wed May 1, 2024 — 13:00–13:30 PT (16:00 ET)
- Option C: Thu May 2, 2024 — 08:30–09:00 PT (11:30 ET)

Please let me know who from Hydra will join (we currently have Monica on deck and I can bring our Solutions Engineering lead if requested). I attached a short one-pager and a MAP template to help scope the agenda. I can also send a Calendly link if you'd prefer to book directly.

Attachments: redwood_intro_onepager.pdf (PDF), hydra-map-template.xlsx (Excel)

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com
redwood.com

--

Priya (CTO) will join for the initial session and our SRE lead, Marcus Lee, should join the technical deep dive — Marcus asked about seeing KV cache and multi-region routing behavior specifically.
